items.en: Class, what do you know about natural disasters like earthquakes, typhoons, floods, and wildfires?
items.zh: 同学们，关于地震、台风、洪水和野火这些自然灾害，你们了解些什么？

items.en: They are very powerful and dangerous.
items.zh: 它们非常强大，也非常危险。

items.en: That’s right.
items.zh: 说得对。

items.en: When it comes to earthquakes, what should people do to stay safe?
items.zh: 说到地震，人们应该怎么做才能保证安全？

items.en: If an earthquake happens, we should stay calm and quickly find shelter to protect ourselves from falling objects.
items.zh: 如果发生地震，我们应该保持冷静，迅速找到躲避处，保护自己不被掉落的物体砸到。

items.en: Great advice!
items.zh: 好建议！

items.en: And what about typhoons?
items.zh: 那台风呢？

items.en: How can we prepare for them?
items.zh: 我们该怎么防范？

items.en: For typhoons, we should stay indoors, away from windows and from any dangerous objects outside.
items.zh: 遇到台风，我们应该待在室内，远离窗户和外面任何危险的物体。

items.en: We should shut all windows and doors.
items.zh: 我们应该关好所有门窗。

items.en: Good points.
items.zh: 说得好。

items.en: Now, let’s talk about floods.
items.zh: 现在，我们来谈谈洪水。

items.en: What actions should we take during a flood?
items.zh: 洪水来临时我们应该采取什么行动？

items.en: We should go to higher ground.
items.zh: 我们应该去地势较高的地方。

items.en: Never try to walk or drive through flood waters.
items.zh: 千万不要试图步行或开车穿过洪水。

items.en: They can be dangerous.
items.zh: 洪水可能很危险。

items.en: Earthquakes can occur anytime without warning.
items.zh: 地震随时可能发生，毫无预警。

items.en: So it is important to be prepared and know how to protect yourself.
items.zh: 所以，做好准备、知道如何保护自己很重要。

items.en: What should you do if one happens?
items.zh: 如果地震发生，你该怎么做？

items.en: Stay calm as the earth begins to shake.
items.zh: 大地开始摇晃时，要保持冷静。

items.en: If you are inside when the earthquake starts, get under a table or a bed.
items.zh: 如果地震开始时你在室内，就躲到桌子或床下。

items.en: You need to have something strong around you to protect you from falling objects.
items.zh: 你需要身边有坚固的东西，保护你不被掉落的物体砸到。

items.en: Do not stand near walls or windows.
items.zh: 不要站在墙边或窗边。

items.en: Stay out of the kitchen.
items.zh: 不要待在厨房。

items.en: Also, never get into a lift during an earthquake.
items.zh: 还有，地震时千万不要乘电梯。

items.en: If you are outside, get to an open area as fast as you can.
items.zh: 如果你在室外，要尽快到空旷的地方。

items.en: Stay away from buildings and trees.
items.zh: 远离建筑物和树木。

items.en: If you are in a vehicle, pull over to a place far from trees or tall buildings and stay in the car.
items.zh: 如果你在车里，把车停到远离树木或高楼的地方，并留在车内。

items.en: If you are close to the sea, try to get as far away from the water as possible.
items.zh: 如果你靠近海边，要尽量远离海水。

items.en: Earthquakes can cause huge, dangerous waves that appear rapidly.
items.zh: 地震可能引发巨大而危险的海浪，而且来得很快。

items.en: When the earthquake is over, there is still plenty of danger.
items.zh: 地震结束后，仍然有很多危险。

items.en: If you see a fire, quickly move outdoors to an open area.
items.zh: 如果看到火，要迅速转移到室外的空旷处。

items.en: Keep an eye out for things that can fall on you.
items.zh: 留意可能砸到你的东西。

items.en: Only make necessary phone calls.
items.zh: 只在必要时打电话。

items.en: Too many calls will bring down the phone system.
items.zh: 太多电话会让通信系统瘫痪。

items.en: Staying calm can improve your chances of survival in an earthquake.
items.zh: 保持冷静能提高你在地震中生存的机会。

items.en: It is not easy, but it can save your life.
items.zh: 这并不容易，但能救你的命。

items.en: Disasters are terrible.
items.zh: 灾害很可怕。

items.en: Sometimes, secondary disasters are even more dangerous because they create more damages.
items.zh: 有时候，次生灾害更危险，因为它们会造成更多破坏。

items.en: Secondary disasters include landslides, fires, floods, and so on.
items.zh: 次生灾害包括山体滑坡、火灾、洪水等。

items.en: Here is a serious example.
items.zh: 下面是一个严重的例子。

items.en: On March 11, 2011, the largest earthquake ever recorded in Japan caused great destruction.
items.zh: 2011年3月11日，日本有记录以来最大的地震造成了巨大破坏。

items.en: Tsunami waves hit the coastal area less than half an hour later.
items.zh: 不到半小时后，海啸浪涛袭击了沿海地区。

items.en: They also destroyed the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant.
items.zh: 它们还摧毁了福岛第一核电站。

items.en: In the following days, explosions rocked the plant.
items.zh: 在接下来的几天里，爆炸震动了核电站。

items.en: More than 150,000 people had to leave the area.
items.zh: 超过15万人不得不离开该地区。

items.en: Lots of radioactivity got into the ocean and came down from the atmosphere.
items.zh: 大量放射性物质进入海洋，并从大气中落下。

items.en: In August, 2023, the Japanese government began to release the radioactive water from the Fukushima plant into the ocean.
items.zh: 2023年8月，日本政府开始把福岛核电站的放射性废水排入海洋。

items.en: The water could have a deep impact on sea life and the environment.
items.zh: 这些水可能对海洋生物和环境产生深远影响。

items.en: People living in coastal areas around the world are worried.
items.zh: 世界各地生活在沿海地区的人们都很担心。

items.en: The radioactive water from the plant is still considered harmful today.
items.zh: 直到今天，核电站的放射性废水仍被认为有害。

items.en: The earthquake highlighted an important problem — disasters often cause a chain reaction, leading to more problems.
items.zh: 这次地震凸显了一个重要问题——灾害常常引发连锁反应，带来更多问题。

items.en: If people do not deal with them properly, it will lead to greater disasters.
items.zh: 如果人们处理不当，就会导致更大的灾难。

items.en: It is everyone’s responsibility to take action to reduce disasters or secondary disasters.
items.zh: 采取行动减少灾害或次生灾害，是每个人的责任。

items.en: Typhoons are strong storms with powerful winds.
items.zh: 台风是伴有强风的猛烈风暴。

items.en: They usually occur in the Western North Pacific.
items.zh: 它们通常发生在西北太平洋。

items.en: Typhoons form when warm water from the ocean meets special wind patterns.
items.zh: 当海洋的暖水遇到特殊的风型时，就会形成台风。

items.en: Typhoons can bring heavy rain and help cool down hot summers.
items.zh: 台风能带来大雨，也有助于给炎热的夏天降温。

items.en: However, they can be very dangerous and cause a lot of damage.
items.zh: 然而，它们也可能非常危险，造成大量破坏。

items.en: During a typhoon, wind speeds can reach up to 252 kilometres per hour or even higher.
items.zh: 台风期间，风速可达每小时252公里甚至更高。

items.en: This can lead to trees falling, buildings getting damaged, and some areas flooding.
items.zh: 这可能导致树木倒伏、建筑物受损，以及一些地区发生洪涝。

items.en: Wildfires are big, out-of-control fires.
items.zh: 野火是失控的大火。

items.en: They happen in natural places like forests and grasslands.
items.zh: 它们发生在森林和草原等自然区域。

items.en: They can badly hurt animals, plants, and the environment.
items.zh: 它们会严重伤害动物、植物和环境。

items.en: They are also dangerous to people living nearby.
items.zh: 它们对附近的居民也很危险。

items.en: In 2023, Canada experienced many big forest fires, affecting an area of over 60,000 square kilometres.
items.zh: 2023年，加拿大多次发生大规模森林火灾，影响面积超过6万平方公里。

items.en: Floods are huge amounts of water covering an area.
items.zh: 洪水是覆盖大片区域的巨量水流。

items.en: They happen when there’s too much rain or when rivers overflow.
items.zh: 当降雨过多或河流泛滥时，就会发生洪水。

items.en: Floods can hurt a lot of people and destroy farms, buildings, and roads.
items.zh: 洪水会伤害许多人，摧毁农场、建筑和道路。

items.en: In China, one of the biggest floods was the 1998 Changjiang River flood.
items.zh: 在中国，最大的洪水之一是1998年长江洪水。

items.en: The PLA troops fought against this terrible flood and protected millions of people from drowning.
items.zh: 解放军部队抗击这场可怕的洪水，保护了数百万人免于溺水。

items.en: They successfully kept major cities like Wuhan safe.
items.zh: 他们成功守住了武汉等大城市的安全。

items.en: On June 1, 2013, an earthquake hit Ya’an, Sichuan Province.
items.zh: 2013年6月1日，四川省雅安发生地震。

items.en: When the building began to shake, a teacher at Fengcun School shouted to his students, “Earthquake!
items.zh: 教学楼开始摇晃时，凤村学校的一位老师朝学生们大喊：“地震了！

items.en: Run!”
items.zh: 快跑！”

items.en: He opened the door at the same time.
items.zh: 他同时打开了门。

items.en: All the students bent down, covered their heads with their hands, and quickly left the building from the front door in order.
items.zh: 所有学生都弯下腰，用双手护住头，从前门迅速有序地离开教学楼。

items.en: Amazingly, they all made it safely within just seven seconds, without any injuries.
items.zh: 令人惊讶的是，他们全都在短短七秒内安全撤离，没有人受伤。

items.en: From this incident, we can learn much about how to respond in times of danger.
items.zh: 从这件事中，我们可以学到很多在危险时刻如何应对的方法。

items.en: Overcome your fears and act quickly.
items.zh: 克服恐惧，迅速行动。

items.en: The moment you feel the disaster coming, you should act without thinking twice.
items.zh: 一旦感觉到灾害来临，就应该毫不犹豫地行动。

items.en: Work with others.
items.zh: 与他人合作。

items.en: Teamwork increases survival chances.
items.zh: 团队合作能提高生存机会。

items.en: In times of disaster, the best survival strategy for people is usually to follow the group.
items.zh: 在灾害发生时，人们最好的生存策略通常是跟随群体。

items.en: Do escape drills.
items.zh: 进行逃生演练。

items.en: Disasters can happen at any time.
items.zh: 灾害随时可能发生。

items.en: Practice often so you don’t have to stop to think during a real emergency.
items.zh: 经常练习，这样在真正的紧急情况下就不必停下来思考。

items.en: Remember: survival = calm + will to survive + knowledge of escape
items.zh: 记住：生存 = 冷静 + 求生意志 + 逃生知识

items.en: Floods are common natural disasters.
items.zh: 洪水是常见的自然灾害。

items.en: They can cause serious damage to homes and crops, and pose a threat to human lives.
items.zh: 它们会对房屋和农作物造成严重破坏，并威胁人的生命。

items.en: Many countries take all kinds of measures to prevent floods based on their specific conditions.
items.zh: 许多国家根据自身具体情况，采取各种措施防洪。

items.en: The Three Gorges Dam plays a crucial role in preventing floods in China.
items.zh: 三峡大坝在中国的防洪中起着至关重要的作用。

items.en: This dam is located on the Changjiang River and helps control the flow of water during heavy rains.
items.zh: 这座大坝位于长江上，有助于在暴雨期间控制水流。

items.en: The dam acts as a barrier to hold back excess water and releases it slowly and safely.
items.zh: 大坝像一道屏障，拦住多余的水，再缓慢、安全地排放。

items.en: This makes sure that the areas nearby are protected from the floods.
items.zh: 这确保了附近地区免受洪水侵袭。

items.en: By controlling the water levels, the dam keeps people safe.
items.zh: 通过控制水位，大坝保障了人们的安全。

items.en: The Thames Barrier is an important flood defense system in the UK.
items.zh: 泰晤士河防洪闸是英国重要的防洪系统。

items.en: It is located on the River Thames with huge gates that can be raised during high tides to protect London from flooding.
items.zh: 它位于泰晤士河上，巨大的闸门可以在高潮时升起，保护伦敦免受洪水侵袭。

items.en: The barrier has successfully prevented many floods since its completion in 1982, safeguarding the city and its people.
items.zh: 自1982年建成以来，该防洪闸成功阻止了多次洪水，守护了这座城市和市民。
